about: Non-gobble wild turkey sounds used only as wrong-call negatives in test/calibration.test.ts. Not shipped in the app. Licenses checked on each recording page. trimStartSec/trimEndSec are seconds in the original file.

clips.author: Jonathon Jongsma
clips.modifications: Trimmed; decoded from MP3 (44.1 kHz) and converted to mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV. No filtering or gain change.
clips.notes: Wrong-call negative for calibration, not a reference. Short isolated clicks measured on the spectrogram; Phase 1 called these putts, not confirmed by an expert. Original remarks: nervous calls and foraging sounds from 3 adults after juveniles flushed. Clip holds two strong clicks (~0.38 s and ~1.32 s) and fainter ones: each a ~40 ms click whose energy sweeps up from about 1.4 to 3 kHz, plus a faint broadband tick.

Original remarks: agitated calls from 2 juveniles perched above the recordist. Clip holds five ~40 ms clicks about 0.35-0.55 s apart; energy sweeps up from about 1.5 to 5-6 kHz with a broadband tick at the onset.

clips.author: Jonathon Jongsma
clips.modifications: Trimmed; decoded from MP3 (48 kHz (resampled to 44.1 kHz)) and converted to mono 44.1 kHz 16-bit WAV. No filtering or gain change.

Original remarks: nervous calls from a female on a trail. Clip holds one ~40 ms click (~0.5 s) sweeping up from about 1.5 to 4 kHz; louder background noise below 1.5 kHz and insect/bird tones near 4.3 kHz.
